caption: The drawing features three distinct objects rendered in black ink on a beige background. The largest object, taking up the majority of the upper half, resembles a caliper or a hinged measuring tool, composed of two elongated, flat pieces joined at one end, with one arm curved and the other straight, both showing wood grain texture and fastened with visible screws or rivets. Attached perpendicularly to the straight arm is a short, horizontal bar secured with two screws. Below this assemblage is a smaller object, visually separate and positioned horizontally; it has a cylindrical handle with a round loop on one side and a short protruding peg or pin beneath the handle. The entire composition is enclosed within a thin, rectangular frame, and the background is plain, without additional illustration or shading.
title: Shutter Hinge and Fastener
